text:
Oh, how I wish death could fall on me, like dry leaves fall from trees. I was deeply reminded of a friend. He doesn't care about me. We stopped talking. We won't talk ever again. He will forget me. I would be dead for him. 

It is possible that someday in future, if someone of my name shows up in his life, he would not recall even then, that I existed. I am lost and it grieves my heart as much as it grieves my soul!
